## Musik 1.8.1

- **Devices like on Spotify**: a device button in the player (phone: next to play, desktop: next to the queue, full player: under the buttons). It opens a list with the current device on top and the other connected devices below. Tap one and the music plays there: phone speaker, Bluetooth headphones, wired or USB headphones. When the sound is not on the phone, the device name shows in colour under the song.
- Buttons to pair a Bluetooth device and to open the system picker.
- **No more duplicate songs on artist pages**: the same song as album track, single, deluxe or remaster now shows once (Spotify, Deezer and your own files). Albums with the same name show once too.

Update the server too (Settings → Updates), the app shows the pages your server delivers.
